# Canvas for AI

> Tools for agents, to display things in a canvas for the user.

- [Tool data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/janpmz/canvas-for-ai/main/catalog.json): tasks, access, example_prompt, example_url.
- [UI Design Editor](https://uidesigneditor.com/): editable designs.
- [PDF TO MP3 Canvas](https://pdftomp3.com/canvas/): send text through its public API; no account or plugin. [Example](https://pdftomp3.com/canvas/?example=1).
